auditType: FINAL DATABASE + BACKEND REAL PRODUCT FORENSIC AUDIT

priceRootCause.cause: Hardcoded fallback currentPrice values in MongoDB MarketplaceProduct populated by seedAllProducts.js. Controller calculates minPrice using Math.min(...), returning ₹2,999.

imageRootCause.cause: masterCatalogData.js assigned Unsplash URL photo-1511707171634-5f897ff02aa9 with dummy &idx=N params across hundreds of products.

criticalAnswers.q4_areImagesRealExactProductImages: NO (809 records use generic stock Unsplash URLs)
